Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 03 July 2025(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Cavite, Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Pampanga, Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Balayan, Calatagan, Tuy) and Laguna(San Pedro, Binan, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Quezon, Nueva Ecija and Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac and Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text:
ORANGE RAINFALL WARNING UP IN ZAMBALES, BATAAN AS HABAGAT RAINS PERSIST

PAGASA hoisted an Orange Warning over Zambales and Bataan as of 9:30 a.m. Thursday due to intensified southwest monsoon rains—flooding is threatening in these areas.

The state weather bureau also reported the Yellow Warning remains in effect for Metro Manila, Bulacan, Pampanga, Rizal, Cavite and parts of Batangas and Laguna, where flooding in flood-prone areas is possible.

📸 PAGASA
